articles.headline: Swift launches blockchain-based shared ledger with 16 banks
articles.summary: Swift’s blockchain-ledger rollout could affect cross-border payments, treasury operations, and settlement speed for banks and multinational companies. If it scales, it may reduce friction in round-the-clock payments and reshape competition around stablecoins and other payment rails.

articles.headline: Samsung says chip shortage could extend to 2028
articles.summary: Samsung’s warning that the chip shortage may last until 2028 matters for companies that depend on memory and other semiconductors for devices, servers, and AI infrastructure. A prolonged shortage can keep input costs high, delay hardware deployments, and force procurement teams to revise supply plans.

articles.headline: Tech stocks tumble as investors question AI spending and China competition
articles.summary: Technology shares fell sharply as investors reassessed the scale of AI infrastructure spending and the competitive threat from Chinese memory-chip makers. The move matters for businesses because it signals possible pressure on cloud, chip, and AI infrastructure costs, while also affecting supplier valuations and investment plans across the tech stack.
